ULT.bo_safe_harbour.source: Article 4 of 公告2018年第9号 (cn.sta.2018-09#i4): direct recognition covers only the government of the other contracting party, a company resident in and listed in the other contracting party, an individual resident in the other contracting party, or a person held 100% by one of these. EKH is a Singapore company listed in Hong Kong (prospectus cover), delisted from the SGX on 2010-09-27 (pdf 143: we were delisted from the SGX-ST on 27 September 2010), and held before listing by NEKCG and King Card (pdf 152); it falls under none of the items.

HOLD.bo_safe_harbour.source: Article 4 of 公告2018年第9号 (cn.sta.2018-09#i4): Best China (Hong Kong) is held 100% by EKH (a Singapore company); EKH is not the Hong Kong government, a Hong Kong resident listed company or a Hong Kong resident individual, and Best China itself is not listed, so it falls under none of the items. Taking the status through the 100% holder under Article 3 still requires EKH itself to be the beneficial owner on the overall analysis of Article 2, which is a determination and is not answered here.
